user.title: Configure Deye EW11
user.description: Enter connection details for your Deye inverter.

data_description.host: The IP address of your EW11 dongle (e.g. 192.168.1.103)
data_description.battery_capacity: Total battery capacity in kWh used for SOC calculations
data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from the inverter (1-60 seconds)
data_description.use_cache: Keep showing the last successful data if the connection fails temporarily
data_description.max_cache_age: Number of failed updates before marking the entity as 'Disconnected'

data_description.update_interval: Frequency of data updates in seconds
data_description.use_cache: Show old data instead of 'Unavailable' during glitches
